panels.title: Important monitoring errors in last 5m

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({cluster="boinc", job="docker"} |~ "(?i)(level=error|fatal|panic|exception|permission denied|failed to connect|unreachable|pull access denied|statusCode=500|cannot connect to docker|host key verification|access denied|connection refused|TLS handshake timeout|i/o timeout)" !~ "(?i)(context canceled|scheduler_processor.go|retry.go|finished query|error processing request|error processing requests from scheduler|closing iterator|error notifying scheduler|error notifying frontend|error health checking|grpc: the client connection is closing|rpc error: code = Canceled|use of closed network connection|EOF|user token not found)"[5m]))

panels.description: Counts actionable monitoring/deploy failures. Loki/Grafana query-cancellation noise is shown in log panels but excluded here.
